api.unexpected: An unexpected server error occurred. Contact the system administrator.
api.concurrentUpdate: Another user has updated this record. Reload it before saving.
api.databaseUpdateFailed: The database update failed. Contact the system administrator.
api.foreignKey: Other records reference this data. Remove those records or their links before continuing.
api.validationFailed: The input is invalid. Check the field values.
api.network: Cannot connect to the backend API. Check that the service is running at {baseUrl}, then refresh this page.
api.unauthorized: Unauthorized (401). If sign-in is enabled, sign in to obtain a Token.
api.conflict: Other records reference this data. Remove the related child records or their links before continuing.
api.forbidden: Permission denied (403). Viewers can only view and query data.
api.environmentMismatch: Safety check blocked the request: WEB is {webEnvironment} and API is {apiEnvironment}. Writes are prohibited because the environments differ.
api.ssoExpired: The Portal SSO request has expired.
api.ssoSignature: The Portal SSO signature is invalid.
api.ssoReplayed: The Portal SSO request has already been used.
api.accountAmbiguous: This AD account matches multiple SPC users. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.employeeAmbiguous: This employee number matches multiple SPC users. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.identityConflict: The AD account and employee number belong to different SPC users. Contact an administrator; accounts will not be merged or created automatically.
api.employeeBound: This employee number is linked to another AD account. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.accountDisabled: This SPC operator account is disabled.
api.legacyProvisionDenied: The legacy sign-in exchange cannot create users. Sign in again through the portal with complete account and employee-number information.
api.localLoginDisabled: Local password sign-in is disabled in SPC. Use your AD account or employee number.
api.jwtNotConfigured: Auth:JwtKey is missing or too short (at least 32 characters).
api.viewerWriteDenied: Viewers can only view and query data. They cannot add, edit, delete or import data.
